O.outcome_detail: synchrony between IPn spike activity and orbicularis oculi EMG

cells.quote: The strongest correlation in the initial conditioning session (r = 0.7063) is found when the EMG has shifted backward 10 ms. In contrast, during the halfway session, the maximum coefﬁcient was observed at lag 0 (r = 0.7746)— that is, during the middle process of the learning, the two signals were strongly related. Importantly, in the ﬁnal session, maximum cross-correlation was found at lag +1( r = 0.7781). Taken together, these results indicate that classical conditioning modiﬁes and improves the synchrony between IPn neuronal activities and the O.O EMG during the acquisition of the conditioned response.
cells.note: Cross-correlation was calculated over the 350 ms CS-US presentation period.
